Edit image1 only, keeping the red fire-talisman BOY identity, camera, whole-canvas framing, head/body size, face, hair, costume and the existing two arm-to-hand chains (RIGHT five-card fan, LEFT bell). Images2–4 preserve this boy's identity and established rendering. Image5 is ONLY a motion/mechanics reference: borrow the clear planted shoe and knee/ankle loading, never the archer girl, bow, green outfit, or her framing. Only correct the forward anatomical LEFT calf/ankle/shoe (viewer RIGHT lane) to CONTINUED PLANTED SUPPORT after landing. That shoe must stay flat, not lift its toe again. Show red/black shoe upper and a thin horizontal gold rim; remove the visible brown outsole face. Toe and knee point straight to screen bottom, ankle takes weight, preserve existing knee flex and foot lane. Rear RIGHT leg stays curled behind airborne. Image5 demonstrates same left support. Keep every upper-body part, face, hair, hands, FIVE cards, bell, costume and camera framing unchanged. Output one full1254x1254 RGBA transparent sprite. Do not add ground art or shadows. No global rescale or recenter.
